parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true and reside in Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Harness/AudioPlayerTestHarness.swift. The methods AudioPlayerTestHarness.simulatePlaybackStarted (line 231) and AudioPlayerTestHarness.simulateRecovery (line 304) are test-harness simulation helpers whose structural similarity (Jaccard 0.7857) reflects the shared scaffolding pattern of test event simulation rather than accidental duplication. Merging or abstracting them would couple distinct simulated lifecycle events — playback start vs. recovery — into a shared implementation, obscuring the intent of each test scenario and making the harness harder to read and maintain.
